# Keep the Light 1.45.0

- **Plex-style names now show every kind of HDR a file has,** in this order: `DV` (Dolby Vision), then `HDR10Plus` (HDR10+), `HDR10`, or `HDR` (for HLG). For example `Movie (2020).2160p.HEVC.DV.HDR10.mkv` or `TV Show (2021).S01E01.Episode Name.1080p.HEVC.DV.HDR.mkv`. Dolby Vision profile 5 (no HDR picture of its own) is just `DV`.
- Works for new files and on the Plex names tab. Files named earlier with a single tag will show up there as ready to rename.
